Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rahter not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was heading through on the green light when another car came in
from the side.
Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you see before impact?
A: I was going straight through. I saw the light was green for me. The other vehicle came across my path and struck
the driver's side of my car.
Q: Were you able to brake or swerve before the impact?
A: I hit the brakes as soon as I noticed the car, but there wasn't enough time to avoid it.
Q: Did you have any injureis at the scene?
A: I had a stiff neck and my lower back hurt right away. I didn't think much of it at first.
Q: Have you sought medical care since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to a clinic the next day. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me a treatment plan.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I have physical therapy twice a week and I'm taking over-the-counter pain relievers as needed.
Q: Has the injury limited your daily activities or work?
A: Yes, I've had trouble sitting for long periods and lifting, so I've had to modify my work duties for a while.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll provide any medical records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
